statement: NVIDIA and Palantir announced a supply-chain AI collaboration built on NVIDIA Nemotron open models and cuOpt, first deployed inside NVIDIA's own supply chain.
why: Pairing NVIDIA's open models with Palantir's enterprise platform pulls accelerated computing into industrial workloads beyond model training, widening the addressable demand base for GPUs.

impact.mechanism: Reference architectures from Dell, Cisco, Rackspace and Nebius carry the stack into on-premises and cloud deployments, each of which requires NVIDIA accelerators to run inference.

evidence.excerpt: The partnership combines Palantir's sovereign AI capabilities with NVIDIA's Nemotron open models to enhance supply chain visibility and decision-making.
the deployment utilizes reference architectures supported by Dell Technologies, Cisco, Rackspace, and Nebius for on-premises or cloud deployment options

confidence.basis: Primary NVIDIA newsroom announcement with named technology components, partners and executive statements; the partnership itself is directly attested even though no volumes are given.
